decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module it fits the firm's existing postpress automation knowledge and modular portfolio, and its continued standalone web presence through 2024 suggests the firm can support, learn from, and further commercialize it.

The folding add-on unit is highly related to the firm's core finishing know-how and already shows customer use in combination with an installed system, so management would likely keep it as an incremental, learnable extension of the existing workflow offer.
